surface: seamless sky-blue studio cyclorama with a soft vertical gradient, no horizon or corners
type_specimen: H1 sample "SHE NEVER GOT A PROCEDURE" in heavy rounded sans caps with a thick dark outline; a caption sample "face oil" in the same face, smaller, pinned to the lower third
color_rules: Cyclorama Blue is background only and never touches a subject; Caption White is type only; skin tones carry the midground
components: a stylised 3D character face caught mid-reaction
a skin macro with pores and dry flaking scales
a skin cutaway whose dermis is a lattice of clear glass spheres
hands entering frame to hold a prop
a clear glass dropper bottle of yellow oil, gold collar, white bulb
a heavy white caption block with a dark outline
construction_logic: stylised 3D character renders, never photographic - smooth subsurface skin, sculpted hair as soft masses, rounded simplified anatomy, shallow macro depth of field
mini_scenes: an oil bead landing on dry skin and spreading
melasma patches fading pale on a cheekbone
a glass pipette with a bulbous tip releasing one bead
motion_signature: slow push-in on a reacting 3D face
an oil bead lands and spreads across skin
a cutaway peels open to the sphere lattice beneath
a pipette tilts and releases one bead
stage: the persistent background world every clip lives on - a seamless sky-blue cyclorama, softly graded, evenly lit, empty and ready for figures and props to enter
finish: no photographic realism or photo textures
no wet pink flesh in the cutaway
